notes.title: NEW Monthly "Holiday" Customization!
notes.content:
Added 12 new monthly "holiday" customization options! All you have to do is play the game and you will immediately unlock the customization associated with the current month. Below is the list of new customization options:


 January: New Years
 February: Valentine's Day
 March: St. Patrick's Day
 April: Easter
 May: Cinco De Mayo
 June: Summer Solstice
 July: 4th of July
 August: Back to School
 September: Oktoberfest
 October: Halloween
 November: Thanksgiving
 December: Christmas
